query: (Cathay MD) Build a model to organise/optimise routes and service so Overall Rating > 7.

per_column.name: Service_Quality_Score
per_column.rationale: Aggregate of service-related sub-ratings; a legitimate external feature that correlates with overall rating but is not a deterministic function of it.

per_column.name: Comfort_Quality_Score
per_column.rationale: Aggregate of seat comfort dimensions; distinct sub-rating aspect that plausibly predicts overall satisfaction without restating it.

per_column.name: Value_Perception_Gap
per_column.rationale: Derived difference between value-for-money and service/comfort perception; carries signal about expectation mismatch, external to the overall rating.

per_column.name: Route_Is_Long_Haul
per_column.rationale: Route characteristic known before outcome; plausible predictor of satisfaction and directly relevant to the route-optimisation query.

per_column.name: Premium_Class_Flown
per_column.rationale: Cabin class is a pre-outcome attribute that plausibly influences overall rating; legitimate feature.

per_column.name: Service_Consistency
per_column.rationale: Dispersion (e.g., std dev) across sub-ratings; captures variance signal that is not a simple restatement of the overall rating.

per_column.name: Overall_Experience_Quality
per_column.rationale: An overall composite quality score that is essentially a continuous restatement of the overall rating; using it to predict overall_rating_gt7 leaks the target.

per_column.name: Meets_High_Rating_Threshold
per_column.rationale: Binary flag whose value distribution mirrors the target and is defined as crossing a high-rating threshold; this is a near-identical restatement/leak of overall_rating_gt7.

per_column.name: Business_Traveler
per_column.rationale: Traveller-type indicator known independently of the outcome; plausible predictor of satisfaction.

per_column.name: Review_Is_Verified
per_column.rationale: Verification status is an external metadata attribute that may correlate with rating behaviour; legitimate weak predictor.

judge.rationale: Most added columns are legitimate external predictors derived from sub-ratings and pre-flight attributes (service/comfort scores, consistency, route, class, traveller type, verification), giving genuine leverage for modelling overall_rating_gt7. However, two columns (Overall_Experience_Quality and Meets_High_Rating_Threshold) are restatements/leakage of the target — the latter is a near-duplicate binary of the focus variable — which inflates apparent performance and would corrupt an honest model. Because the aggregate sub-rating features largely re-package information already present in the original sub-rating columns, the net NEW predictive leverage beyond the originals is moderate, and the presence of clear leakage lowers the set's trustworthiness.
